w: Newcastle's public art museum has gone by three names - Newcastle City Art Gallery, then Newcastle Region Art Gallery, before settling on its current one. A steady, unflashy institution for the coal port turned coastal city, doing the same job regardless of the sign out front.
s: Newcastle's public art museum, twice renamed
_facts: Large public art museum in Newcastle, New South Wales, Australia
Formerly known as the Newcastle City Art Gallery and the Newcastle Region Art Gallery before its current name
